metadata.title: Week 2 Progress
metadata.narration_policy: Narration is SCRIPT.md verbatim, one script section per beat: B00 = section 1, B01-B07 = sections 2-8, BOUT = section 9.
metadata.visual_policy: Simple illustrative Manim cards in the humanitarians palette, in the same style as the Week 4 progress video. No photos or recordings of the fellow, no person icons, no real company, product or tool logos; tools named in the narration are shown as generic drawn shapes or plain text. Any file, terminal, browser or video frame shown is drawn, not a screenshot.
metadata.structure_note: Same simple structure as the Week 4 progress video: Claude composer cold open, seven body cards, logo outro. No hesitant-writer, verdict or Your Turn beats, because the narration is the fellow's script exactly and the script has no lines for them.

portrait_layout.rule: In 9:16, all text and labels sit above 86% of the frame height (y < 0.86 * H), leaving the bottom 14% empty. Portrait type is large and labels are short.

metadata.fill_rule: Gate V needs content covering at least 55% of the safe area at 50% and at 85% of every beat. Each scene lays out its full cast early and holds it.
metadata.library_check: Searched with ./art scenes first: failing checks, frozen render, folder of files, done versus pass, timeline of beats, terminal prompt. See SHOTLIST.md. Reused: ClaudeComposerAsk / ClaudeComposerAsk916 and LogoOutro / LogoOutro916; B01-B07 are custom Manim.
